description.text:
Battle Elite (对战精英) was the first enhanced expansion (强化包) of the Simplified Chinese Pokémon Trading Card Game: a smaller set of strong cards for improving existing decks. It went on sale on 16 December 2022 in packs of six cards, two of them holo. Like Storming Emergence before it, its cards come from the Sun & Moon series.

Blacephalon GX is on its cover. Its other cards include Zeraora GX, Dusk Mane Necrozma GX and Dawn Wings Necrozma GX, the Prism Star cards Tapu Koko ◇ and Ditto ◇, the Unit Energy cards, and the four Battle Chatelaine sisters, Evelyn, Dana, Morgan and Nita, as Supporters. Its main cards are numbered out of 60; full-art, rainbow and gold cards run to 88.
